pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygons with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patch area is maximal on the mid-flank and reduces significantly in size and connectivity toward the ventral and lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected topological graph of light-cream pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively uniform across the upper flank but exhibits higher variability where patches fragment.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a short, upright 1D contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency serration against the background from the upper neck to the scapular region.
